integrations.prompt: While ticket-review task-generation writes task files for a task that touches UI files or UI behaviour: load the frontend skill and apply references/plan.md; Acceptance needs docs/FRONTEND.md widths (narrowest, its common widths, both sides of each touched breakpoint), a WCAG 2.2 AA contrast line, visible labels, keyboard, axe with its scope, and tokens, each line checked in a browser; non-goals explain any skipped.

While execute-task runs on a task that touches UI files or UI behaviour: load the frontend skill and follow its implementation rules from references/design-system.md, references/figma.md when a design is linked, and references/browser.md for browser self-checks.

While verify-task runs on a task that touches UI files or UI behaviour: load the frontend skill and independently verify each UI Acceptance item in a browser with references/verify.md and references/browser.md; keep verify-task's read-only verdict format, and when the check finds a UI defect, have the main thread show the user the findings with evidence before dispatching a fix.

While pr-review runs on a change that touches UI files or UI behaviour: load the frontend skill and independently review the UI in a browser for rendered behaviour, accessibility, console/network evidence, and design-system use before the pr-review verdict, and when the check finds a UI defect, have the main thread show the user the findings with evidence before dispatching a fix.

While wrap-up runs after a change that touches UI files or UI behaviour: load the frontend skill and offer a host-browser human review of the main routes, states, and viewports; the human review is advisory, not a gate.
